instruction: Keep the Level node aligned to the viewport with position (53, 5.5), scale (0.65, 0.65), and rotation 0. Keep Sprite2D using assets/sprites/platformer_coins.jpg with centered set to false. Add a Node2D named GemstoneHighlights under the Level node. Inside GemstoneHighlights, create a semi-transparent Polygon2D named GemstoneHighlight. Shape and place the polygon so it closely covers the gemstone.
